## Checks / 检查

- [ ] The change is focused; generated localization and official IDs are untouched. / 改动集中，未修改生成本地化或官方ID。
- [ ] Text and translation claims are supported; a one-language proposal is clearly marked. / 事实有依据，单语言提案已说明。
- [ ] No review status was promoted without a real review. / 没有擅自提升审核状态。
- [ ] Relevant checks are listed below; unperformed tests are not marked passed. / 列明实际检查，未执行项不写通过。
- [ ] I can share this contribution under the applicable MIT or CC BY-SA 4.0 terms and have identified third-party material. / 有权按相应许可提交，第三方材料已说明。

Validation / 实际验证:

For content proposals, maintainers apply accepted changes to the research ledger and regenerate the publication data before release. / 正文提案采纳后由维护者回写研究主库，再生成发布数据。
